The main takeaway from our work is that

the Wasserstein distance is an effective metric for modeling the distribution of the dialogue responses and that the Gaussian mixture prior is an effective way to enrich the latent variable space for dialogue modeling.
the latent variable distribution can be learned in a data-driven manner and the resulting model can generate more diverse responses.
